### Context

`PRICE_TABLE_MICROCENTS_PER_MTOK` is a hard-coded dict with a handful of models. Any other model is silently charged Sonnet prices, so budgets and reported cost can be far off.

### What to do

Move prices to a small data file, add current models, and log a warning (once per run) when a model has no price.

### Done when

Unknown models are visible, and adding a price needs no code change.

### Where to look

`src/meridian/runtime/proxy/budget.py`
